newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Mortar fire heard close to Zaire's Lubumbashi city.
newsitem.headline: Mortar fire heard close to Zaire's Lubumbashi city.

text.p: Mortar fire exploded on Monday on the outskirts of Zaire's second city of Lubumbashi, which has been declared the next main target by rebels, witnesses said.
"It sounds to me like incoming 120 mm mortar fire landing about seven km (four miles) south of the city," a military expert in the city said.
Explosions first erupted around 8.45 p.m (1845 GMT) and were continuing half an hour later.

Residents said they suspected the firing was from Laurent Kabila's rebels who were closing in on the copper mining capital. Earlier in the day a Zaire government army commander said the rebels were about 15 km (10 miles) from the city.
